svg.title: Plate 1, the whole. On the left the parts: vault, page, space, rule, watch, key, link, event and seal. On the right Conky as a cross-section made of those parts: git at the centre, then pages, reflexes, spaces, characters and an outer wall of lenses, with connectors, models and people plugging into ports in the wall. Solid is built, dotted is planned.
svg.text: the whole is made of these
